name: Lightpanda | Headless Browser for AI Agents and Scraping (CDP)
description: Lightpanda headless browser: Playwright and Puppeteer over CDP, ~30 MB
card_desc: Lightpanda, the headless browser written in Zig for AI agents and scraping: Playwright, Puppeteer and chromedp connect over CDP, behind a token gate, with private networks blocked. Starts instantly and idles at a few dozen MB.
